## 1. Native macOS Workstation Suite (6 Applications)

### 1.1 EmDoc PDF Workstation
- **Landing Page**: https://cogify.me/products/emdoc
- **Comparison Guide**: https://cogify.me/compare/emdoc-vs-adobe-acrobat-pdf-expert
- **Direct DMG Download**: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/EmDoc.dmg
- **Binary Size**: 5.0 MB Universal Binary (7.5 MB DMG)
- **Active Memory Footprint**: ~45 MB RAM on 500-page PDF
- **Architecture**: ISO C++20 Core + Swift 6 + PDFKit + Apple Vision Neural Engine OCR
- **Capabilities**: Bates numbering, cryptographic stream redaction, vector-preserving PDF compression, split/merge/reorder, form filling & digital signatures, offline OCR.

### 1.2 LumenView — External Monitor Brightness, HiDPI & LUT Controller
- **Landing Page**: https://cogify.me/lumenview
- **Privacy Spec**: https://cogify.me/lumenview/privacy
- **Comparison Guide**: https://cogify.me/compare/lumenview-vs-betterdisplay-lunar
- **Direct DMG Download**: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/LumenView.dmg
- **Binary Size**: 7.8 MB DMG (v2.4.0)
- **Active Memory Footprint**: ~18 MB RAM
- **Architecture**: Swift + Metal 3 + IOKit I2C DDC/CI + CoreDisplay + ScreenCaptureKit
- **Capabilities**: Native Mac keyboard brightness/contrast/volume keys on third-party HDMI/DisplayPort/USB-C monitors, custom HiDPI Retina scaling up to 240Hz, 3x1D GPU Gamma tables + 3D .cube LUT import, 60 FPS Virtual Displays & Picture-in-Picture, 6 Desktop HUD widgets.

### 1.3 Metricove — Menu Bar System Telemetry & Fan Controller
- **Landing Page**: https://cogify.me/metricove
- **Privacy Spec**: https://cogify.me/metricove/privacy
- **Comparison Guide**: https://cogify.me/compare/metricove-vs-istat-menus-stats
- **Direct DMG Download**: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/Metricove.dmg
- **Binary Size**: 2.3 MB DMG
- **Active Memory Footprint**: ~11 MB RAM (<0.2% CPU overhead)
- **Architecture**: Swift 6 + Mach Host APIs + IOKit + Apple SMC
- **Capabilities**: Per-core Apple Silicon P/E CPU telemetry, GPU & ANE utilization, unified memory pressure & swap, NVMe SMART & disk I/O, per-process network bandwidth, 25+ SMC thermal sensors & custom fan RPM curves.

### 1.4 NetGuard — Outbound Application Firewall & Socket Monitor
- **Landing Page**: https://cogify.me/netguard
- **Privacy Spec**: https://cogify.me/netguard/privacy
- **Comparison Guide**: https://cogify.me/compare/netguard-vs-little-snitch-lulu
- **Direct DMG Download**: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/NetGuard.dmg
- **Binary Size**: 3.8 MB DMG
- **Active Memory Footprint**: ~24 MB RAM
- **Architecture**: Swift + Apple NetworkExtension (`NEFilterDataProvider`) + Metal 3D Globe + Local MaxMind ASN
- **Capabilities**: Real-time outbound connection prompts, Apple code-signature verification, interactive 3D Metal GeoIP connection map, 500,000+ domain DNS sinkhole, Focus/Lockdown modes, Pcap/JSON/CSV export.

### 1.5 Klipora — Encrypted Clipboard Manager & Bento Pasteboard
- **Landing Page**: https://cogify.me/klipora
- **Privacy Spec**: https://cogify.me/klipora/privacy
- **Comparison Guide**: https://cogify.me/compare/klipora-vs-paste-maccy-raycast
- **Direct DMG Download**: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/Klipora.dmg
- **Binary Size**: 3.1 MB DMG
- **Active Memory Footprint**: ~19 MB RAM
- **Architecture**: Swift + SQLite WAL + FTS5 + CryptoKit AES-256-GCM + Apple Vision OCR
- **Capabilities**: Sub-5ms Bento grid clipboard history, offline image OCR text extraction, sequential Paste Queue (`Cmd+Shift+V`), Touch ID AES-256-GCM encrypted vault, automatic 1Password/Bitwarden/Keychain exclusion.

### 1.6 Show Free Space — APFS Disk Space Analyzer & Menu Bar Monitor
- **Landing Page**: https://cogify.me/show-free-space
- **Privacy Spec**: https://cogify.me/show-free-space/privacy
- **Comparison Guide**: https://cogify.me/compare/show-free-space-vs-daisydisk-cleanmymac
- **Direct DMG Download**: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/cogifyme/releases/download/v1.0/ShowFreeSpace.dmg
- **Binary Size**: 4.2 MB Core (.appex)
- **Active Memory Footprint**: ~14 MB RAM
- **Architecture**: Swift + POSIX `getattrlistbulk` + APFS Snapshot Inspector + WidgetKit
- **Capabilities**: True purgeable-aware APFS free space in menu bar, interactive multi-ring sunburst storage chart, developer cache scanner (`DerivedData`, `node_modules`, Docker, Homebrew), local Time Machine snapshot inspector.
